default.p.goukaku2_n4-t13-p1.vietnamese:
The number of people who do not eat breakfast is steadily increasing. The increase is particularly noticeable among people in their 20s (ages 20 to 29). Apparently, among people in their 20s, one in three men and one in five women do not eat breakfast. Why do they skip breakfast? It is because more people are staying up until late at night. When they stay up late, they do not feel hungry in the morning even after waking up. It is said that it is best to eat dinner before 8:00 p.m. and go to bed before midnight. Apparently, many people cannot work or study well in the morning if they do not eat breakfast. In addition, many people become ill.

At one junior high school, the number of students who did not eat breakfast was increasing, so the school decided to prepare a meal at school once a week. Apparently, students who came to school early to exercise and those who did not have time to eat breakfast were using this service. The students were very happy, but some parents reportedly said: 「I want my child to eat breakfast at home」.
